stations.title: 1 · Move & Look
stations.text: Left stick or WASD to walk. Drag the right side of the screen to look around.

stations.title: 2 · Fly
stations.text: Tap FLY (or press F). Up/Down buttons climb and dive. Tap again to land.

stations.title: 3 · Teleport
stations.text: MENU › Teleport lists landmarks. One tap and you are there.

stations.title: 4 · Menus
stations.text: MENU opens the tile grid. Drag lists to scroll, tap ✕ to close.

stations.title: 5 · Minimap & World Map
stations.text: Minimap is top-right. Tap it for the World Map. Pinch to zoom, tap to teleport.

stations.title: 6 · Chat · IC / OOC
stations.text: Talk opens chat. IC = in character. Wrap OOC text in (( double brackets )).

stations.title: 7 · Wardrobe & Avatar
stations.text: Avatar edits your look and DNA. Wardrobe swaps outfits and attachments.

stations.title: 8 · Building
stations.text: Companions can place and dig blocks. Ask them in Talk: 'build here'.

stations.title: 9 · Combat Zone Rules
stations.text: Damage only happens inside red-ringed combat zones such as Ember Arena. Everywhere else is safe.

stations.title: 10 · Getting Help
stations.text: Ask the Welcome Guide or the Help Desk any time. MENU › Help works anywhere.
